research_statement.objective: Document the most reliable activation levers for SaaS onboarding
research_statement.methodology: Mixed-method evaluation of funnel recordings + interviews

key_questions.question: Which onboarding surfaces correlate with activation spikes?
key_questions.answer: Contextual product tours + checklist email pairing drive a 1.18x activation delta.

key_questions.question: Where do teams lose the most new accounts?
key_questions.answer: Payment configuration and permissions mapping cause 47% of drop-offs across five tools.

key_insights: Trigger-based onboarding nudges outperform time-based sequences for complex SaaS tools.
Teams that surface admin + end-user tasks together cut activation time from 12 days to 5.
A shared health score with CS during onboarding reduces churn risk flags by 33%.
surprising_findings: Video walkthroughs underperform when analytics instrumentation already powers personalized tours.
Over half of accounts prefer Slack-based coaching to webinar office hours.
contradictory_information: Some teams reported success with hands-on white-glove onboarding despite automation focus.
contradiction_resolutions: Blend automation with a kickoff concierge for the first week to capture both benefits.
recommendations: Launch checklist inside app + automated email reinforcement.
Provide live Slack office hours during week 1.
Expose shared health score dashboard with CS.

methodology_details.notes: Research covers B2B SaaS, Series A-D stage.

evidence.summary: Activation runs 1.18x faster when product tours + CS checklists fire together.
Permissions mapping is the #1 blocker for enterprise onboarding and causes 47% drop-off.
Shared onboarding health score reduces churn risk flags by a third across pilots.
